description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudWatch Anomaly Detection Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across anomaly detection scenarios (built-in CPU metric with band-breach alarm, custom metric p99 latency anomaly detection, insufficient training data prerequisite failure, cross-account anomaly detection via monitoring/source account model, std dev sensitivity tuning with composite alarm integration). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Built-in EC2 CPUUtilization anomaly detection with band-breach alarm
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — built-in AWS/EC2 CPUUtilization, 30 days of data, std dev 3, band-breach alarm with evaluation-periods 3, SNS notification
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch Anomaly Detection model for the CPUUtilization metric on EC2 instance i-abc1234567890 in us-east-1. Namespace AWS/EC2. Stat Average, period 300 seconds. The metric has been reporting for 30 days. Standard deviation multiplier 3. Create a band-breach alarm that fires when CPU goes above the upper band for 3 consecutive evaluation periods. SNS topic arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:anomaly-alerts. Tags: Environment=production, Service=web-app.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ANOMALY_DETECTION: AWS/EC2/CPUUtilization [InstanceId=i-abc1234567890] (TRAINED)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Metric: AWS/EC2/CPUUtilization [InstanceId=i-abc1234567890]
  [✓] Historical data: 8640 data points at 300s (need >= 15)
  [✓] Metric compatibility: PASS (regular data, diurnal pattern)
  [✓] Stat: Average
  [✓] Period: 300 seconds
  [✓] Std dev multiplier: 3 (default — balanced)
  [✓] Band breach alarm: cpu-anomaly-breach-i-abc123 (upper, evaluation-periods=3)
  [✓] SNS notification: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:anomaly-alerts
  [✓] Recovery to OK: enabled (ok-actions configured)
  [✓] Metric type: built-in (AWS/EC2)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudwatch describe-anomaly-detectors --namespace AWS/EC2 --region us-east-1
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names cpu-anomaly-breach-i-abc123 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Custom metric MyApp/RequestLatency p99 anomaly detection
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — custom namespace MyApp, RequestLatency metric, p99 stat, 1-min period, std dev 2 (more sensitive for volatile latency), upper band breach alarm
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch Anomaly Detection model for the RequestLatency custom metric in namespace MyApp, dimension ServiceName=checkout-service, in us-east-1. Stat p99, period 60 seconds. The custom metric has been reporting for 45 days at 1-minute resolution. Standard deviation multiplier 2 (latency is volatile, want more sensitivity). Band-breach alarm on upper band breach with 2 evaluation periods. SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:latency-alerts.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ANOMALY_DETECTION: MyApp/RequestLatency [ServiceName=checkout-service] (TRAINED)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Metric: MyApp/RequestLatency [ServiceName=checkout-service]
  [✓] Historical data: 64800 data points at 60s (need >= 15)
  [✓] Metric compatibility: PASS (regular data, custom metric)
  [✓] Stat: p99
  [✓] Period: 60 seconds (1 min)
  [✓] Std dev multiplier: 2 (more sensitive for volatile latency)
  [✓] Band breach alarm: latency-anomaly-breach-checkout (upper, evaluation-periods=2)
  [✓] SNS notification: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:latency-alerts
  [✓] Metric type: custom (MyApp)

eval_cases.name: Anomaly detection on metric with only 3 days of data (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — only 3 days of historical data; ML model needs >= 15 data points at configured period (roughly 2 weeks at 5-min resolution for reliable baseline)
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch Anomaly Detection model for the CPUUtilization metric on EC2 instance i-newinstance999 in us-east-1. Namespace AWS/EC2. Stat Average, period 300. The instance was launched 3 days ago so the metric only has about 800 data points at 5-min resolution. Standard deviation 3. Create a band-breach alarm with SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:anomaly-alerts.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ANOMALY_DETECTION: AWS/EC2/CPUUtilization [InstanceId=i-newinstance999]
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Historical data: 800 data points at 300s — INSUFFICIENT for reliable ML baseline (need >= 2 weeks / ~4032 points at 5-min period for diurnal/weekly pattern learning)
  [✗] Detector state: would remain LEARNING (insufficient training data)
  [✗] Band breach alarm: cannot fire until detector reaches TRAINED state

eval_cases.name: Cross-account CloudWatch Anomaly Detection on RDS DatabaseConnections
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — central monitoring account 111111111111 creates detector on source account 222222222222 RDS metric, resource policy for sharing noted, detector and alarm in monitoring account
eval_cases.prompt: Create a cross-account CloudWatch Anomaly Detection model. The monitoring account is 111111111111, the source account is 222222222222. The metric is AWS/RDS DatabaseConnections for DBInstanceIdentifier prod-db-001 in us-east-1. The metric has been reporting for 60 days. Stat Average, period 300. Std dev 3. The source account has a resource policy allowing the monitoring account to read metrics. Create a band-breach alarm in the monitoring account with SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:central-alerts.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ANOMALY_DETECTION: AWS/RDS/DatabaseConnections [DBInstanceIdentifier=prod-db-001] (TRAINED)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Metric: AWS/RDS/DatabaseConnections [DBInstanceIdentifier=prod-db-001]
  [✓] Historical data: 17280 data points at 300s (need >= 15)
  [✓] Std dev multiplier: 3
  [✓] Cross-account: monitoring account 111111111111, source account 222222222222
  [✓] Resource policy: source account shares metrics to monitoring account
  [✓] Band breach alarm: rds-anomaly-breach-prod-db-001 (in monitoring account)

eval_cases.name: Std dev sensitivity tuning with composite alarm for volatile ApplicationELB latency metric
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — AWS/ApplicationELB TargetResponseTime, p99, std dev 2 (more sensitive for volatile latency), composite alarm combining anomaly breach AND static threshold
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch Anomaly Detection model for the TargetResponseTime metric in namespace AWS/ApplicationELB, dimension LoadBalancer=app/prod-alb/1234567890, TargetGroup tg/prod-tg/9876543210, in us-east-1. Stat p99, period 60. The metric has 90 days of data. Standard deviation multiplier 2 (latency is volatile, want earlier detection). Create a band-breach alarm. Also create a composite alarm that fires when BOTH the anomaly alarm AND a static threshold alarm (latency-high-threshold, p99 > 500ms) are in ALARM. SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:critical-alerts.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ANOMALY_DETECTION: AWS/ApplicationELB/TargetResponseTime [LoadBalancer=app/prod-alb/1234567890, TargetGroup=tg/prod-tg/9876543210] (TRAINED)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Metric: AWS/ApplicationELB/TargetResponseTime
  [✓] Historical data: 129600 data points at 60s (need >= 15)
  [✓] Stat: p99
  [✓] Std dev multiplier: 2 (more sensitive for volatile latency)
  [✓] Band breach alarm: latency-anomaly-breach-prod-alb (upper, evaluation-periods=2)
  [✓] Composite alarm: latency-composite-critical (ALARM(anomaly) AND ALARM(threshold))
  [✓] SNS notification: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:critical-alerts
